avis.titre: AMAZING
avis.texte: I’m not exaggerating when I say that these are the best sheet masks I have ever used. I love the variety, and they are the first ones that don’t make me wake up with a breakout in the morning. My only gripe is I wish there was no fragrance added, but the smell is very mild and pleasant and like I said it doesn’t cause any irritation. Leaves my skin looking beautiful. Very affordable considering how many you get. Very minor stickiness after mask is removed, each one makes my skin feel plump and hydrated. So great for a self-care evening.

avis.titre: Powerful and affordable face masks.Powerful and affordable face masks.
avis.texte: Love, love, love these masks! I have a cool little spa closet that I created filled with various goodies such as face, hand, foot, eye, hair, and steam masks. Along with bath soak packs and shower steamers. I work a stressful job so at the end of a long work day I love to unwind and treat myself while also promoting self care and relaxation. I have tried various masks and not all are equal. These stand apart because I truly love the smell and they come soaked in serum. It says twenty minutes, but I usually wear them through a 30-40 min meditation until they are semi dried out so my skin really soaks in all that goodness. My complexion has been the best it’s ever been and I credit these mask’s with helping. The quantity for the price is worth it when you think about the fact that at Walmart or Target one face mask can run you $2-$4 dollars and they really aren’t all that special don’t get me wrong those are perfect for like a single spa day event, but if you use face mask’s routinely cost wise you have to look at other options and these are the best plus the packaging kind of looks cuter than many other brands. I highly recommend these face mask’s!!! : )

avis.titre: LOVE THESE!!!  ♡♡♡LOVE THESE!!!  ♡♡♡
avis.texte: I have purchased these face masks multiple times, and I will definitely keep buying them! The price is great for what you get, the shipping is super fast, and the variety is wonderful. They are super easy to use/apply and there is no smell (at least I do not notice a smell). I have been using them for several months now, a few times a week, and I truly see a difference. They moisturize, nourish, and leave my skin feeling soft, refreshed, and happy! These are excellent...I honestly love these sheet masks! Love the masks, love the price, love the results...I Highly Recommend them!!! :-) ♡♡♡

avis.titre: Very thick residue, works well
avis.texte: I really like these. The ointment on them is very thick, so it's not totally dry when you take it off your skin and you know you're getting a lot of good hydration. So far I haven't felt too much difference between the different types, but the aloe vera one did feel like it was soothing my skin more than the hemp one did so they do seem to basically do what they're saying. After taking them off and patting in the remaining ointment there's a lot of remaining sticky residue so you might want to have some other moisturizer or something handy to finish rubbing it in or just prepare for a light rinse to get the rest off if you don't want your face collecting lint and things afterwards. The next day my skin feels baby soft and revitalized, and looks a lot more fresh!

avis.titre: Great for self care
avis.texte: Very hydrating and great for self care and it doesn’t have a scent so that’s a bonus for me

avis.titre: Great value and work really well with a jade roller
avis.texte: I love these masks! I’ve reordered twice now and use them 2 x week. I use an inexpensive jade roller over the mask and I feel this really helps with the absorption. My skin is definitely plumper, more moisturized and my makeup goes in so smoothly for a day or two after use. They are a good value and inexpensive to use frequently. Are they going to roll back 10 years? No, but I do feel they are a good addition to your skin care routine and they just feel good

avis.titre: Huge texture and redness improvement!
avis.texte: I have pretty sensitive skin - adult acne, redness, lots of texture. It’s a constant fight to find products that work for me and don’t irritate my skin further. I was hesitant to buy these masks because of the low cost, but I was leaving for a work trip and wanted something to find to soothe my skin after flying. I cannot express how much I love these masks. I’ve tried all of them, and they leave my skin feeling so soft, essentially eliminated texture overnight, and helped my redness a ton. I will definitely be repurchasing over and over. I don’t use them every night, but rather 2-3 times a week. Couldn’t recommend more.

avis.titre: Salon effects at homeSalon effects at home
avis.texte: These are super messy coming out of the packet, you need to be ready for bed before you to apply and ready to lie down immediately after application. The hydrogel structure is a little fragile and you do need to be careful not to rip or drop it as you apply your mask. Out of the packet, it is a white colour but as it soaks into your face it becomes translucent and see through. A top and bottom part of the mask allows you to adjust better for the shape of your face. Once on, you will notice that there is a lot of product still left in the bag and so we use that to moisturise our arms and legs. Overnight, you need to be careful not to roll around too much, if you don’t have this level of subconscious control, it’s better to maybe do a few hours instead. Hydration is good and better if you put hyaluronic acid on before you but the face mask on. Following up with a cream the next morning just seals everything into the skin. There are four individually packed face masks in the packet.

avis.titre: Very good
avis.texte: These are very good set of face masks. It comes in a pack of 4 and I really like that they come individually packaged which means using one doesn't mean you're affecting the other 3, which some other similar products who use an all in one packaging does. The hydrogel masks feel pretty dense out of the pack and you can definitely feel its properly soaked in serum. It's not soaking wet that it drips everywhere but I did notice some product left over on the packaging and I feel this is a positive note considering you really want the mask to not be dry before using it. The mask is made of 2 different pieces. Applying is pretty simple although if you have a smaller face, some parts might require some more time manipulating the shapes but as the masks are quite wet, it makes it easier for them to stay on and they are able to stick to your face pretty good even if you're walking around. You're supposed to keep them on until the opaqueness turns into clear, which I think is pretty cool as you can have a visual indicator to know that there's something going on. Upon removing, my skin felt really hydrated and I feel it does a good job firming the skin and reducing fine wrinkles. Overall a very satisfactory pack of masks that's worth the price.

avis.titre: Great valueGreat value
avis.texte: Delivery was prompt. 20 sheet masks packaged neatly. There are four masks of each variety. Have tried a few so far and happy with how they feel. Easy to use as they’re not overflowing with serum unlike popular brands from the supermarket. This can be a hit or miss depending on your personal preference. Minus one star because one of the varieties has a strong perfume smell that irritates me. Would buy again though as the pack is great value!

avis.titre: Not Magic… But Pretty Close for the PriceNot Magic… But Pretty Close for the Price
avis.texte: Cooling, non-sticky and quite hydrating - this feels like a bit of an upgrade from regular sheet masks. ✅ Pros: - Super cooling and refreshing on the skin - Leaves skin soft, smooth and feeling more hydrated - Thick hydrogel holds moisture (doesn’t dry out quickly) - Two-piece design = better fit and easier adjustment - Turns transparent as it absorbs (kinda satisfying to watch) - Decent value ❌ Cons: - Runs large on smaller faces - Can feel very cold (not ideal in winter) - Results are mostly short-term glow/hydration - Wearing for hours/overnight isn’t the most comfortable

avis.titre: Very nice, beautiful skin, love these
avis.texte: 10/10, love these. You get a glassy soft skin. It’s gorgeous!! Nice price and travel friendly. I will continue to purchase these. I also sent some to my sister an and she loved them as well.

avis.titre: Cooling, refreshing facial mask with nice firming effect
avis.texte: I ordered the four-pack of Collagen Hydrogel Face Masks by NEXTBEAU. This was my first time trying a hydrogel type of face mask. I had heard great things about Korean skincare from others, so I was excited to try this type of mask The masks come in two pieces that are applied to the top and bottom of the face. Applying the mask was easy and the mask did cover a good portion of my face. However, it adhered better to some parts of my face than others. As a whole, the mask generally stayed in place on my face the entire time, but there were some areas that were loose and hanging throughout most of the experience. I applied it on freshly washed skin without toner or serum. The mask is unscented which I appreciated since I am sensitive to some fragrances and don't care for others. The hydrogel mask felt different than typical peel-off masks that I have used in the past, in a positive way. It did not feel sticky or tacky. I liked that I could even wear my glasses over the mask without getting a sticky, wet mess on them. The best part of the mask for me was how cooling and refreshing it felt the entire time it was on. I really enjoyed that effect. Around the second hour I could feel it tightening to my face more and you could see that the mask was becoming more transparent. I removed the mask at just under two and one-half hours when I started to get tired of the feeling of having it on my face. After removing the mask, my face did not have that dewy, glowing, wet look that the list

avis.titre: The Ultimate Skin Reset! 🧖‍♀️✨
avis.texte: This variety pack is fantastic! It covers everything I look for in a skincare routine—from hydration and firming to targeting acne and aging. It’s truly a one-stop shop for all the essentials. My skin feels great after each use, and the masks themselves are beautifully made. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Korean sheet masks ❤️
avis.texte: Those mask leave ur skin feeling like glass I buy these all the time and use on a regular basis you won’t regret this purchase these are Korean face masks and if you know about Korean skin products you know they are the best will be buying here soon as I get low on them 10/10 5 stars

avis.titre: Affordable and leaves a fresh glow! Highly recommend!
avis.texte: Got these today and used the Intensive & Firming mask first this evening. I love the glow and softness it leaves on my face. Smell is light and clean. I have a pretty big face and forehead. I was able to stretch it just a little bit to fit most of my face. Lots of juice left in the pack to spread around neck, chest, and hands. I look forward to using the other packs while I travel this weekend. Definitely worth $9! I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Easy to apply and super hydrating.
avis.texte: Leave my skin feeling really good and don’t make me break out. I use these at about for a party and all the girls seem to love them.

avis.titre: Super wet.
avis.texte: Super hydrating, but the mask is super wet and it's kinda uncomfortable. Liquid will drip, I wore my UV mask with it worked pretty well but it's extremely wet

avis.titre: brightening and hydrating
avis.texte: I got these sheet masks before and I'm buying them again because they make my skin look so amazing the next day! by far these are my favorite sheet masks. very hydrating and brightening. get this!

avis.titre: Cooling Hydrogel Mask That Delivers Deep Hydration
avis.texte: These collagen hydrogel masks feel incredibly refreshing and hydrating on the skin. The gel material has a cooling sensation when applied, which makes the experience feel very soothing and relaxing. I used the mask as part of my normal skincare routine. After cleansing, toning, and applying my serum, I placed the mask on as the final step to help lock in hydration. It provided an extra boost of moisture that my skin really needed that evening. The hydrogel texture sits nicely on the skin and feels much more substantial than typical sheet masks. It stays in place well and allows the skin to absorb the hydrating ingredients while you wear it. After removing the mask, my skin felt noticeably softer, smoother, and well hydrated. My complexion also looked more refreshed and healthy. Overall I really enjoyed using these masks and appreciate the deep hydration they provide. They are a great addition to a nighttime skincare routine when your skin needs extra moisture. Summary Highlights Cooling hydrogel texture feels soothing on skin Provides deep hydration and moisture Works well after cleansing, toning, and serum Leaves skin feeling soft and smooth Comfortable mask that stays in place Great for adding extra hydration to skincare routine

avis.titre: Good Results With This Hydrogel Mask
avis.texte: These Nextbeau Collagen Hydrogel Face Masks arrived as a pack of four individually wrapped masks. Each mask consists of two pieces and each piece is contained between sheets of plastic. I found them easy to put on with no tearing, they fit the skin well, were appropriately sized and have a nice thickness. I found that they started to go transparent on my forehead after about an hour and I left it on for another hour when it was starting to dry out. My skin felt very soft afterwards, I had no reddening of my skin which sometimes happens with collagen products but not with this mask. There's a little slick feeling to my skin as the layers of the mask lock in hydration. Overall I'm very satisfied with this mask and its effectiveness in creating a smoother skin tone and bright appearance.

avis.titre: Loving it
avis.texte: Loving it so far! Starts off as an opaque white mask, but gradually becomes mostly transparent after about 2 hours. After use, leaves my skin feeling soft, moisturized, supple, and not greasy! The scent is mild, so even someone like me with sensitive skin can use it without worry. Also works great to startle the hubby or the kids. Contains Hydrolyzed Collagen, Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, Peptides, and a whole slew of other ingredients. Contains 4 mask in the package. Half of the instructions are in korean, but the english translation is clear and written well. About 3 years expiration date. Made in Korea.

avis.titre: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️Luxury Sheet Masks That Deliver — Great Value & Gorgeous Results!
avis.texte: I’m very impressed with this NEXTBEAU Pack of 20 sheet masks — they check every box for me! The value is excellent given how many different types you get, and the quality truly feels luxurious on the skin. Each mask is durable and well-made (no flimsy nonsense that tears as you unfold), and the serum is generous without being sticky or greasy. Even the packaging that holds the masks feels elevated. The scent is subtle and pleasant, not overpowering — just a clean, spa-like fragrance that makes the whole experience relaxing. Application is super easy; the masks sit smoothly and stay put so you can move around while they do their job. Most importantly, they leave my skin deeply hydrated, plump, and glowing every time. Perfect for quick self-care nights or whenever your skin needs a boost. I have sensitive skin and have not experienced any issues with these masks. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: So many masks!
avis.texte: This is a really nice selection of good quality Korean made sheet masks. My review could begin and end with that because it really is as simple as that but I’ll share a little more about my experience… So far I’ve tried 3 out of the 5 types of masks. I found the masks to all be soaked in a generous amount of serum with enough left over to either reapply to your face or use elsewhere. The masks themselves are sturdy and large and I imagine would cover most anyone’s face. They’re made of a white cotton-like gauze type of material that is common in sheet masks. They’re easy to unfold and hold up well. There’s no risk of tearing or ripping these masks like there is with the gel type. I thought each of the 3 I tried were moisturizing and nonsticky. They gave my skin a quick boost without leaving any residue or unnatural looking shine. My skin just looked clean and hydrated. Which is exactly what I wanted. I have some very expensive face masks and I love them but I don’t always have the luxury of sitting around wearing a mask for 2-3 hours! And I’m also not going to whip out an expensive mask just to wear it for 10 minutes and toss it! Oftentimes I’m just looking for a quick fix and these masks are a perfect for the task. At the current price they’re less than $1 per mask! That makes for guilt free pampering! A quick note about hyaluronic acid. If either your skin or the environment around you is dry, hyaluronic acid will actually dry out your skin. It works by drawing moisture to

avis.titre: Variety pack for different skin needs
avis.texte: I love having options and this set gives me plenty to choose from depending on what my skin needs each day. The sheet mask itself was super soft and fit my face well. I really love that all these masks have a lightweight essence. It adds so much moisture but never leaves my skin feeling sticky or heavy. There was even extra in the packet to pat onto my neck and chest. After twenty minutes my skin felt incredibly hydrated and plump. The thirsty feeling was completely gone. Overall, each mask addresses a different concern effectively. My skin has been looking clearer more hydrated since I started using them. I love being able to give my face a little spa treatment at home. I would definitely recommend this pack to anyone who enjoys sheet masks and wants a great variety to have on hand.

avis.titre: Face Mask Made Up Of Two Halves Require More Attention When Applying And Has Uneven Coverage
avis.texte: Nextbeau Collagen Hydrogel Face Mask is the first face mask that I have tried that is pre-cut into two halves. The order includes 4 individually wrapped sheet masks. I was surprised to find that each half was sandwiched between two thin sheets of plastic. The material of the mask is not the familiar thin cloth-like material. It feels like a pliable, thin, firmer gel-like product. When it came to the application, because it is made up of two specific halves that I had to line up, I had to be more careful than with the traditional full face mask. It wasn't overly difficult to apply but I did need to be more conscientious to ensure the halves lined up and covered my entire face. Unfortunately, I noticed that the mask left noticeable spaces on the sides of my nose that were not covered with the mask. When it came to the lower half of the mask , it would not adhere to my chin and left a distinct ripple effect on the bottom edge.The mask is saturated but not soppy and drippy and is a noticeably bright white color when I started the process. After 10 minutes of wear, I found that the bottom half started to slide down and I needed to adjust the mask so it would fully cover my skin. Interestingly, the manufacturer stated "when the mask turns transparent, remove it and gently massage the remaining essence onto your face" but did not state an estimated wear time. I found that it took about 15 minutes for me. Once removed, there was minimal serum remaining to rub into my skin with a hint

avis.titre: Feels refreshing, but hard to fit face
avis.texte: NEXTBEAU's Facemasks are not bad, but they're not great. This is a pack of ten which contains two masks of each of the following: Aloe Vera Solution, Collagen Solution, Niacinamide Solution, Hyaluronic Solution, and Hemp Seed Solution. The masks were very hydrated and saturated with the solution and comparable to other face mask experiences. The mask itself, however, was a bit out of proportion or sizing for my face. The mouth and eye holes were oversized, the nose flaps weren't quite long enough, and it was difficult to position the mask without it wanting to tear away. The solutions itself though were very soothing and comforting and felt nice on the areas that were actually covered by the mask. Overall it is a fair deal for the price point but I do not think I would purchase this again. It was refreshing but it just left me wanting a better experience.

avis.titre: WARNING: not for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: These masks are not for people who have sensitive skin, because they contain fragrance. If your skin is sensitive, these masks may give you tiny little bumps on your face as a reaction. I removed the mask before it got worse. I love the value for the price, but I hate the fact that they contain fragrance.

avis.titre: Good value
avis.texte: These collagen hydrogel masks are, in my opinion, pretty standard. I've tried better, I've tried worse. They come in two pieces, which is definitely helpful when you're trying to get a good fit for your face, but I still had to make some rips and cuts to make it lay flat in several areas (but I think that's pretty standard with these types of masks, as we all have unique facial structure). The pieces are fairly fragile and will rip if you don't handle them carefully. They're soaked in a generous amount of serum, with a puddle of it left in the packaging that you can pat onto your neck or your face after you remove the mask (but it's VERY sticky, so your face will stay tacky for quite some time if you do so). I kept the mask on for several hours, until it started detaching around my mouth and chin from me eating. I wish I could sleep in these types of masks, but I just can't manage to, I find it too uncomfortable. When I removed the mask, my face felt very soft and hydrated. It didn't leave my skin with the glow that some other brands do, but those brands are also typically pricier, so it's understandable. My face stayed feeling moisturized all night and still felt nice the next morning. I feel like it made my night products last longer because my face was more hydrated (for reference, I'm 57 and have dry, mature skin). All in all, I feel that, at just over $4/mask, these are a good value for the price point. I would definitely recommend them if you want the experience of a hy

avis.titre: Refreshing cool moist facial mask treatment for hydrating, brightening and smoothing your skin
avis.texte: This NEXTBEAU collagen hydrogel face masks are a nice treat for my wife. While she uses different creams, oils and gels on her face, she has never used a mask that you place directly on the skin covering your face. But she likes these. Each of the 4 masks come in a securely sealed pouch inside a cardboard envelope. When you remove the two pieces from the envelope, you need to handle with care as they are very delicate. Then you simply peel each piece from the protective film and place them on the forehead and over the lower portion of your face. The very first impression is the soft, cool, moist feel of the sheets on your skin. They are comfortable and adhere well in that they stay on the face when upright and moving around. However there were a couple of small areas that she could not get to stay sealed to the skin. With the niacinamide, a mix of peptides and multiple botanicals infused in the mask, it provides much needed nourishment to revitalize the texture of your face. Immediately after removing the mask after her first treatment, you could see how smooth and even toned (bright) the skin looked. And the feel of the skin was soft and smooth all over to the touch. After her second mask treatment, she felt her experience was much the same as the first. These masks are very easy and clean to use. Each of the two pieces goes on effortlessly and they come off with no residue left on your face. There is no need to rinse your face after use and you can resume your normal facial

avis.titre: Plump and hydrated after my first mask!
avis.texte: This hydrogel mask left my skin feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, and plump after the first use. My face felt smooth to the touch and looked noticeably refreshed once I removed it. I didn't experience any redness or irritation. The mask is unscented. The box includes four individually wrapped masks, and each packet has its own instructions printed directly on it. The directions are provided in both Korean and English and include simple illustrations that make the process easy to follow. Each mask is divided into a top and bottom section, which makes it easier to fit different face shapes and sizes. Each hydrogel piece is sandwiched between two clear plastic layers that keep it saturated in serum. There is no front or back to worry about. Just peel off the plastic layers and place the hydrogel directly onto your face. One thing I really like is that the instructions suggest applying your own serums first on a clean dry face before placing the mask on top. I used four of my own serums and then applied the mask. This makes the mask very customizable depending on what your skin needs that day. Because my face is small, the top and bottom sections overlapped slightly. If you move around a lot the mask can shift a little and may need to be slid back into place. I also would not recommend eating or drinking unless you are using a straw because the mouth opening is intentionally small so it covers the delicate skin around the lips. I left mine on for about two and a half hours and n

avis.titre: Easy to place and incredibly hydrating
avis.texte: Hydrogel masks are my favorite type of sheet mask because they adhere well to the skin after a few minutes, usually come in two pieces for a better fit, and tend to feel very hydrating. This mask checks those boxes for me. It includes ingredients like collagen, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, peptides, and mugwort, which are commonly used for hydration and overall skin support. It is designed as an overnight mask, but I was not able to keep it on all night. That said, I was able to wear it for about four hours at a time without issue. It did start to lose adhesion over time, which is likely why I could not keep it on overnight. My skin responded really well to these masks. Living in a dry climate, I rely on products that help keep my skin feeling hydrated and comfortable, and these fit nicely into that routine. After removing it, there was a light layer of serum left that absorbed easily without feeling sticky. The next morning, my skin felt soft and refreshed. The two piece design helps with placement and allows for good coverage across the face. Overall, these masks worked well for my needs, even without overnight wear. At $16.99 for a pack of four, they feel competitively priced and a good value based on my experience.

avis.titre: Hydrogel mask x4, skin feels baby soft, glowing - but hydrogel during winter can be too chilly
avis.texte: The hydrogel clings to your face well and starts to turn transparent as the essence absorbs. The fit is large I definitely had more than enough mask for my face. I did love the results, I notice my skin looked tighter and less 'blah' the next day. It felt softer too, I kept wanting to touch my face, it was baby soft. The formula is packed with collagen, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and peptides, plus a mix of botanical extracts like ginseng and mugwort - I love it! Especially for 4 sheets in the pack, that's a solid value. The printed directions mentions it can be worn overnight but...uh...my sensory relationship with hydrogel...I have a love/hate relationship with hydrogel masks, especially during winter. I love how cooling it is, NextBeau collagen mask gave me great result but the super cold wet feeling during winter months makes it so hard to focus on sleeping. It's easy to use and easy to put on, didn't slip too much, but I couldn't shake the feeling. Overnight use is not possible for me but I tried my best to have it on for 1-2 hours with still nice results the next day. I just took it off before bed instead of sleeping with it on the whole night. If you can handle the super cooling hydrogel material, this is a quality mask set that leaves your skin soft, nourished and glowing.

avis.titre: Refreshing & Hydrating Sheet Masks – Easy to Use and Skin Feels Great After
avis.texte: I picked up the Collagen Hydrogel Face Mask 4-pack because I’ve been wanting to try this type of facial treatment for a while, and I’m glad I did. The masks arrived neatly packaged in an outer envelope, with each one individually sealed. Application was simple and straightforward—no confusion or complicated steps. The masks have a light, pleasant scent that isn’t overpowering, which I appreciated. After using one, my skin felt noticeably clean, smooth, and well-moisturized. It left my face feeling refreshed without any sticky residue. Pros: * Light, pleasant scent * Easy to apply with clear instructions * Leaves skin feeling soft, clean, and hydrated Overall: A nice, fuss-free skincare option that delivers a quick hydration boost. Great for a relaxing self-care moment or when your skin needs a little extra moisture.

avis.titre: So much moisture
avis.texte: I love to have my self care moments after the day winds down, and these are exactly what I had in mind for a relaxing evening. The masks came individually wrapped, and have quite a lot of liquid in them, and that is a good sign. I opened the sheet mask and it smelled so good. The mask itself was very slippery and clung to my face very easily. I had it on to watch TV and forgot all about it, and when I looked in the mirror, the mask was gone, completely turned translucent and more or less disappeared. I padded the rest into my skin and left it alone. The mask is made with botanical extracts and they are responsible for deep hydration and adding moisture. I left it all night, however I do not like that it made my pillow wet, and I had to wash it, but my face looked very plump and very hydrated. My fine wrinkles looked like they filled up over night and disappeared. I am a little sad that I only got four.

avis.titre: Nice easy to use two piece sets, hydrates, fits nice.
avis.texte: I like that these face masks are a thick gel and come in two pieces one for the bottom and one for the top. The two piece design seems easier to adapt to different face shapes and lengths. The thick silicone-like gel also molds better to the face than the paper or fabric style merely because it is more flexible and lightly stretchy. These work just as well as most hydrogel masks it hydrates and adds ingredients that are skin friendly. There are four full masks that four two piece sets in this package. These stay where you put them fairly easily and they are suggested to be left on until it becomes transparent which for me is about an hour but it is going to depend on your skin and the environment/humidity. It starts to go translucent as it begins to dry.
